name: 鸣潮
description: Wuthering Waves stylized rendering pipeline with raw-NdotL banding, bounded specular, GrayRed FaceSDF, Hair masks, and MikkTSpace Body MatCap.
author: MDA

localizedDescriptions.zh-CN: 鸣潮风格化渲染管线：原始法线亮暗带、受限高光、灰度 FaceSDF（支持骨骼追踪）、头发高光遮罩与 MikkTSpace 身体 MatCap。
localizedDescriptions.en: Wuthering Waves stylized rendering pipeline with raw-NdotL banding, bounded specular, GrayRed FaceSDF with bone tracking, Hair masks, and MikkTSpace Body MatCap.
localizedDescriptions.ja: 鳴潮スタイルレンダリングパイプライン：生 NdotL バンド、制限付きスペキュラ、ボーン追従対応 GrayRed FaceSDF、ヘアマスク、MikkTSpace ボディ MatCap。
